# FDG5033

> CONSIDER providing indexers on types representing collections of items.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.2.1 Indexed Property Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: draft

Not an analyzer candidate: many collections (sets, queues) have no meaningful index, so a missing indexer is not a violation.
